items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Harvey had the choice of getting the normal Nestico and Neal Hefti stocks and running the thing... I have to give him credit for that. He doesn't let it out of his sight.

ctx.x: Because there was usually a lot of it and it's out of the way.

Ray Shriner, the oboist, was teaching at Pottsdam and had been with the college orchestra out there; he had some of the things. I don't know how he got it but he had it and he wanted the rest of it and he was coming down to get the stuff out of George Price's barn. So he came down one day and carted it up to Pottsdam. Six months later (inaudible) Harvey at the Y--
